reason: My NRO has sat there for years and I only deal with it on a trip, once every two years. CAD $199 on about 10 lakh is a lot when my bank in India charges a few hundred rupees, and I would just keep putting it off anyway.
objection: A flat $199 for something my own bank does for a few hundred rupees feels like paying a lot for paperwork I could do myself on the next trip.
would_change_my_mind: A fee around $50 to $60 for a 10 lakh move, or proof that my bank's process from Canada is truly impossible without a branch visit.
